purpose: Define which evidence is required to advance each FileSteward execution transition and where failures route for repair.

required: local Git status/head known when local runtime exists
reject_if: handoff relies on historical SHA as current truth
required canonical artifact unreadable

required: one mutation owner per shared file/surface
external prerequisites separate from lane IDs
parallel lanes have disjoint mutation ownership
reject_if: two lanes can write the same shared owner concurrently
dependency encoded as prose masquerading as lane ID
agent must invent product judgment to proceed
lane can silently broaden mutation scope

required: focused tests or exact unavailable status
reject_if: test/oracle weakened to fit implementation
claimed proof exceeds executed proof

required: no stale proof is treated as current
reject_if: consumer proof predates changed producer contract
missing transition/owner reference

required: all material review findings repaired or disproven on exact head
reject_if: passing tests used to override unresolved material review
review assessed stale head after material changes

required: repository-required local suite/validators pass on exact candidate head
reject_if: no local suite was run but merge readiness is claimed
green provider status substitutes for repository-owned proof

required: PR #29 and main refreshed for evidence
dedicated integration/j6-pr29-lineage-20261007 branch created from refreshed main
PR #29 selective-port allowlist/exclusions/shared-file policies applied exactly
reject_if: whole PR #29 branch merged as the convergence strategy
backend lane rewrites visualization
new generic dashboard replaces incumbent world
stale PR #29 snapshot used as present truth
PR #29 safety/deletion/governance files override current main authority
gates.repair_owner: J6 execution owner following the closed judgment contract

reject_if: static strings or HTML inspection presented as live proof
orthogonal state lost
dead click
EXPLORE fallback regression

required: exact semantic action in operator gate
reject_if: repair/delete action exceeds gate
technical uncertainty promoted by urgency
bytes claimed without measurement
broken app ignored after reclaim
receipt scope differs from authorization

failure_semantics.rule: A gate failure invalidates the attempted transition, not the scheduler or unrelated work.
failure_semantics.retry: Repair the named invariant, refresh candidate identity, rerun the failed gate and any downstream gate whose inputs changed.
failure_semantics.no_ceremony: A passing gate is permission to continue under existing authority; do not stop merely to announce the pass.
